purpose: Shared state for staggered ChatGPT research automation workers. Research-only.

scan_policy.rule: Each worker scans all active research branches for substantive changes before working its preferred lane. Process at most one highest-priority substantive cross-lane change plus one safe preferred-lane next action per run. Do not duplicate work already claimed/recorded.

guardrails: Do not touch production/main or production Discord/Spreadsheet/Stable★6/Sniper/Mega/TradingView/watchlist-builder/updater.
2026 outcome is report/robustness-only, never tuning/selection input.
Canonical comparison endpoint is next XTKS session open to fifth XTKS session close.
4H/intraday-led final scoring; daily is context/label/repair/fallback only.
Before editing a lane, verify no newer commit supersedes the state file and no other worker has already processed it.
